learnings: API errors (HTTP 400/500) can silently cause models to skip critical files, producing inconclusive verdicts that trigger unnecessary escalations. The audit tool should implement retry logic or automatic fallback to a different model when API errors occur.

When a report ends in tool errors for critical files (PKGBUILD, .install), it should be treated as having no verdict signal per the adjudication rules, not as a valid 'inconclusive' that forces disagreement resolution.
The initial PKGBUILD top-level audit (which succeeded for qwen) provides a partial safety net but does not replace full review of prepare()/package() functions where injection typically occurs.
